rationale: Both blocking findings from code-review.final are resolved in fix-up commit 7b9bfd4dc. CR-001: _create_backfilled_project_budget now calls _log_zero_equal_share, and a new seam test covers the $0.30/70 backfill. CR-002: the resync seam test now asserts the shared child is seeded with 0.0/0.0; the test fake now mutates the updated row like the real repository. The fix-up diff only adds one log call plus tests, so no new high-risk surface; 232 budget and runtime-sync tests pass.
